summary: Solid implementation with proper error handling (set -euo pipefail, exit codes, argument validation) and extensive documentation. Workflow correctly uses pinned actions and least-privilege permissions. Minor issues: (1) chmod +x in workflow suggests script permissions not set in git; (2) read_changed_files duplicates stdin/file-read logic (lines 180-213); (3) load_rules doesn't strip trailing whitespace from parsed fields, risking subtle matching bugs; (4) global arrays in script are functional but unconventional. Overall well-suited for testing/CI use with fixture files.
